outcome.Summary: Implemented `jpath.Query` in `jpath/jpath.go`: a strict path parser (must start with `$`, no whitespace) supporting `.name`, `["key"]` with `\"`/`\\` escapes, `[N]` with negative indices, `[*]`/`.*` (arrays in order, object values sorted by key), and `..name` recursive descent in pre-order; non-applicable steps yield nothing while malformed paths return an error and nil result. Verified with the provided test plus a thorough temporary spec test (since removed) covering all syntax, error cases, and ordering; `go test ./...`, `go vet`, and `gofmt` all pass.
